integrity: The square-free structural criterion is independently checked by direct divisor-sum arithmetic through \(10^6\). The asymptotic constant is derived symbolically from the Euler product, with a numerical product check supplied only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to square-free integers. It imports the classical Landau–Selberg–Delange theorem and does not claim a sharper error term or a formula for all non-arithmetic integers.
title: A Landau–Ramanujan secondary term for square-free arithmetic numbers
